name: Etapp 16: Marma / Marmafjärden to Älvkarleby turisthotell / Laxön

description.long: Naturkartan and Upplandsstiftelsen give 13 km. The downloaded GPX includes the main stage plus an Älvkarleby station spur; full GPX computes to about 13.403 km and main stage to about 12.599 km.

utilities: Mapped facilities on this section include swimming, rest area, toilet, water, attraction, shelter, fireplace, heritage.
waterSources: Use listed water rows as planning-grade refill information; seasonal access, non-potable warnings, and local signage override static data.
notes: Naturkartan and Upplandsstiftelsen give 13 km. The downloaded GPX includes the main stage plus an Älvkarleby station spur; full GPX computes to about 13.403 km and main stage to about 12.599 km.
Use Naturkartan Etapp 16 GPX as primary geometry.
The GPX direction matches official prose: Marma-to-Älvkarleby.
Preserve the official multi-segment geometry. Segments 0-2 form the main route to Älvkarleby Turisten; segment 3 is an Älvkarleby station access spur.
Do not use the final raw GPX point as the Etapp 17 handoff; use the main-route endpoint at Älvkarleby Turisten/parking.
The inter-segment gap from the main endpoint to the station spur is about 1296.6 m and should not be auto-connected.
